chapters.label: 01 / FACES
chapters.title: Twelve pentagons
chapters.body: Every face is a regular pentagon. The twelve faces are congruent.

chapters.label: 02 / VERTICES
chapters.title: Three meet at a corner
chapters.body: At each of its twenty vertices, exactly three pentagons meet.

chapters.label: 03 / DUALITY
chapters.title: Paired with the icosahedron
chapters.body: Connect the centers of neighboring faces to obtain an icosahedron.
